title: Balanced Brackets
problem: Given one line made only of the brackets ( ) [ ] { }, print "Balanced" if every opening bracket is closed by the matching kind of bracket in the right order, and "Not balanced" otherwise. For example, ([]{}) is balanced and (] is not.

hints.1: Think about which opening bracket each closing bracket has to match, and in what order brackets close.
hints.2: Keep a list of the opening brackets that are not closed yet. For an opening bracket, append it. For a closing one, the list must not be empty and its last item must be the matching opener; then remove it. At the end the list must be empty. Counting brackets is not enough, because the order matters.

failure_explanation: Equal numbers of opening and closing brackets are not enough: each closing bracket must match the most recent opening bracket that is still open, and of the same kind. Handle a closing bracket when nothing is open (instead of crashing), check that nothing is left open at the end, and print the words exactly as shown.
